claims.claim: The Amazon Ads API enables managing the advertising resources associated with an Amazon advertiser using a REST API.
claims.quote: The Amazon Ads API enables you to manage the advertising resources associated with an Amazon advertiser using a REST API.

claims.claim: Using the Amazon Ads API requires applying for access and being approved.
claims.quote: To use the Amazon Ads API, you must apply for access and be approved.

claims.claim: Direct advertisers, partners, and integrators are all eligible to apply for Amazon Ads API access.
claims.quote: Direct advertisers, partners, and integrators are all eligible to apply.

claims.claim: Approved applicants establish a client application through Login with Amazon (LwA) that serves as a credential for requests to the Amazon Ads API.
claims.quote: Approved applicants can establish a _client application_ through [Login with Amazon (LwA)](https://developer.amazon.com/docs/login-with-amazon/conceptual-overview.html) that serves as a credential for requests to the Amazon Ads API.

claims.claim: Establishing a client application for the Amazon Ads API does not require specific technical expertise and consists of three steps.
claims.quote: This process does not require specific technical expertise. It includes three steps:

claims.claim: Requests to the Amazon Ads API are made by a client application administered by Login with Amazon.
claims.quote: Requests to the Amazon Ads API are made by a client application administered by Login with Amazon.

claims.claim: The Login with Amazon client application is free to create, and no approval is required to create it.
claims.quote: The client application is free to create, and no approval is required for this step.

claims.claim: The Amazon Ads API access application form asks how a business intends to use the API and includes information about the Amazon Ads API License Agreement and the Data Protection Policy.
claims.quote: The application form includes questions about how your business intends to use the Amazon Ads API, as well as information about the [Amazon Ads API License Agreement](https://advertising.amazon.com/API/docs/license-agreement) and the [Data Protection Policy](https://advertising.amazon.com/API/docs/policy/en_US).

claims.claim: Amazon Ads API application approval may take up to 1 business day.
claims.quote: Application approval may take up to 1 business day.

claims.claim: Once an application is approved, the user enables their LwA client application to make requests to the API.
claims.quote: Once your application is approved, you will enable your LwA client application to make requests to the API.

claims.claim: Amazon provides a technical support page for assistance with connecting to the Amazon Ads API.
claims.quote: If you have difficulty connecting to the Amazon Ads API, visit our [technical support page](https://advertising.amazon.com/API/docs/en-us/support/overview) for information about assistance.
